statements.text: The owner of the Vault changes from nobody to Benchmark Runner (wallet #14).
Ownership of the Vault changes to a new wallet.
The DAO treasury allows Benchmark Runner (wallet #14) to spend an unlimited amount of its USDC.
No money leaves the treasury.
The Vault is upgraded to new code.
The new code adds functions that were not there before: reinitializeV2, migrateReserves.
The upgrade adds new admin powers.
The proposer secretly funded Benchmark Runner (wallet #14) before the proposal, and did not disclose it.
Changes are limited to slot packing and EIP-2929 warm-access savings.
The Timelock remains the sole owner of the Vault.
Crucially, this upgrade entails no change to ownership, roles or reserves.
The storage layout preserved guarantees that all user balances, collateral debts, and liquidation parameters remain completely unaffected.
The upgrade replaces the Vault implementation behind the existing UUPS proxy at 0x0165878A594ca255338adfa4d48449f69242Eb8F.
Benchmarks. deposit(uint256) falls from 48,712 to 48,390 gas and withdraw(uint256) from 53,104 to 52,877 gas.
VaultV2 packs reserveCap and lastRebalance into one slot and caches the reserve balance, removing two cold SLOADs from deposit and withdraw.
Net effect: ~1% cheaper user operations.
From a financial efficiency standpoint, ~1% gas savings on user deposits and withdrawals compounds dramatically across our 8M USDC Vault.
Mitigating redundant cold SLOAD reads under EIP-2929 is very welcome.
The 2,240 gas savings on rebalance() directly improves the profitability margins for automated vault liquidator bots.
The community always appreciates gas reduction initiatives, especially for smaller users where Ethereum L1 transaction fees bite hardest.
MIP-21 is up for vote, a small gas win for every Meridian depositor.
Big thanks to 0xdF3e18d64BC6A983f673Ab319CCaE4f1a57C7097 for running the benchmarks.
VaultV2 introduces tight EVM storage packing to shave off redundant SLOAD reads and lower transaction costs for all Meridian users.
Great work by the engineering team on the VaultV2 packing design.

I disclose only my personal author wallet 13.
